system.description:
Invests people, places and things with magical blessings, preparing them to receive power. Often has religious overtones.

Sword Chronicle p. 91. A Sorcerous Benefit (Blood of the Sorcerers, Blood of the Far Isles, Natural Sorcerer or Sorcerous Initiation) grants access.
system.tools: Censers and rare incenses, feather fans, holy water and sacred oils for anointing.
system.initiation: Add your Persuasion rank to the Alignment results of all Ritual Works you perform.
